themes_detail.label: Dead Animals Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints spiked to 13 THIS WEEK versus a typical weekly average of 1.0 over the prior 8 weeks—a 1,200% surge (z-score: 10.73)—suggesting a potential public health or environmental crisis in Sunset Park.
evidence: 13 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1,200% spike)
Z-score of 10.73 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Concurrent spike in Animal in a Park complaints (6 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.0 avg) and Unleashed Dog complaints (3 last week vs. 0.1 avg) suggest broader animal-related distress
reporting_angles: Interview NYC Department of Sanitation and NYC Parks to determine source (disease, poisoning, neglect, wildlife conflict)
Canvass Sunset Park residents and park-goers about what they've observed; document locations and condition of dead animals

themes_detail.label: Massive Building/Code Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints exploded to 108 TWO WEEKS AGO versus a baseline of 7.0 weekly—a 1,443% increase (z-score: 29.16)—pointing to potential widespread illegal conversions, overcrowding, or unsafe occupancy in Sunset Park.
evidence: 108 Building/Use complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 7.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1,443% spike, z-score: 29.16)
631 total DOB building permits filed in last 90 days, with 445 alterations—consistent with rapid construction/renovation activity that may lack proper oversight
Community board has standing request for 'Provide more housing for extremely low and low income households,' suggesting chronic housing pressure and possible illegal conversions to meet demand
reporting_angles: FOIL DOB violations and complaints from 2 weeks ago; map cluster to identify neighborhoods within Sunset Park with highest density of illicit units
Interview tenants in newly altered buildings about occupancy density, lease terms, and conditions; speak with DOB about enforcement capacity

themes_detail.label: Sidewalk & Tree Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Sidewalk Condition complaints jumped to 19 LAST WEEK versus 4.9 weekly average (290% increase, z-score: 6.58), while Dead/Dying Tree complaints hit 9 versus 1.4 average (554% spike, z-score: 5.1)—indicating rapid urban infrastructure decay.
evidence: Sidewalk Condition: 19 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 4.9 weekly average (290% spike, z-score: 6.58)
Dead/Dying Tree: 9 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (554% spike, z-score: 5.1)
Community board has standing request for park/amenity expansion, suggesting limited green space and maintenance capacity
reporting_angles: Walk affected blocks in Sunset Park; photograph tripping hazards, cracked pavement, and dead trees; identify geographic cluster
Interview Parks Department on tree maintenance schedules and capacity; request data on deferred maintenance backlog

themes_detail.label: Park Noise & Unleashed Dogs
themes_detail.summary: Noise - Park complaints surged 3,100% to 4 complaints TWO WEEKS AGO versus 0.1 average (z-score: 11.72), while Unleashed Dog complaints hit 3 LAST WEEK versus 0.1 average (2,300% spike, z-score: 8.69)—indicating loss of park safety and amenity quality.
evidence: Noise - Park: 4 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average (3,100% spike, z-score: 11.72)
Unleashed Dog: 3 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (2,300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Concurrent spikes align with broader animal-related distress (dead animals, animals in parks) suggesting ecosystem or enforcement breakdown
reporting_angles: Observe Sunset Park's major parks (Sunset Park, Brooklyn Army Terminal Waterfront) during peak hours; assess park enforcement and signage
Interview Parks Enforcement Patrol (PEP) about staffing and ticketing for unleashed dogs; speak to community about who's creating noise and why

themes_detail.label: Child Safety After Hit-and-Run
themes_detail.summary: A 3-year-old girl was critically injured in a hit-and-run on April 9, 2026—a high-profile incident that converges with longstanding Traffic Signal Condition complaints (435 over 90 days) and community board requests for transit upgrades, highlighting pedestrian safety failures in Sunset Park.
evidence: 3-year-old critically injured in hit-and-run on April 9, 2026 (reported by Gothamist and Brooklyn Eagle)
Traffic Signal Condition complaints total 435 over last 90 days—among top 10 complaint categories
Community board has standing requests for Select Bus Service (SBS) expansion and other transit service upgrades, indicating chronic transportation infrastructure gaps
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD about hit-and-run investigation; obtain driver information and vehicle details when available
Audit traffic signals, crosswalks, and street markings in the location and surrounding blocks; interview DOT about maintenance and safety improvements planned
